title: Lesson
description: A lesson on one concept: a flat list of parts, each filled from one of Planish's templates, shown in order.

$schema.description: Optional; if present, this lesson schema.

commit.description: The full commit the lesson is about; absent for the working tree.

parts.description: The lesson's parts, in the order they are shown.

items.description: A part; its template's schema says what else it holds.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter; unique in the lesson.
